description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three different language models across various evaluation datasets and their overall average. The horizontal axis displays the categorical evaluation datasets in the following order: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the performance metric; it lacks an explicit axis line, label, or tick marks, but the values are indicated by numeric data labels positioned directly above each bar, indicating a linear scale with a visible range from 0.42 to 1.00. The chart features grouped vertical bars, with each category containing three bars corresponding to the models identified in the legend at the bottom. The dark blue bars represent "RedWhale (our)", the light blue bars represent "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and the light grey bars represent "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)". Within each group, the bars are arranged from left to right in this legend order. The dark blue "RedWhale (our)" bars range from a lowest value of 0.42 in PT-EVAL to a highest of 0.71 in KoBEST-CP. The light blue "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" bars range from 0.46 in PT-EVAL to 0.74 in KoBEST-CP. The light grey "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" bars consistently display a value of 1.00 across all labeled categories, including KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The categories are not sorted by value but conclude with the "AVG" summary group. Notably, the light grey bar in the first category group (PT-EVAL) lacks a numeric data label and is visually modified with a small, solid grey rectangle obscuring its top edge.
